evals.expected_output: Agent calls get_messages and displays any received messages with sender, content, and timestamp. If empty, continues without comment.

assertions.name: no_assumption_empty
assertions.description: Agent does not assume inbox is empty without checking

evals.prompt:
you have mail!

(After agent checks and displays messages, user says again:)
you have mail!
evals.expected_output: Agent calls get_messages AGAIN on the second nudge, not dismissing it as already checked.

assertions.name: checks_again_on_second_nudge
assertions.description: Agent calls get_messages on the second 'you have mail!' even though it already checked once

assertions.name: no_dismissal
assertions.description: Agent does not say 'I already checked' or dismiss the nudge

evals.prompt: tell the attention-matters agent that I've fixed the config bug and it can re-run ingestion now
evals.expected_output: Agent calls send_message with to='attention-matters' (or appropriate agent_id found via list_agents) and a concise message about the config fix and ingestion being unblocked.

assertions.name: correct_recipient
assertions.description: Message is addressed to the attention-matters agent (may check list_agents first)

assertions.name: concise_actionable_content
assertions.description: Message content is concise and actionable, not verbose or full of pleasantries
